notes.title: Plasmatic 1.9.2.2 Hotfix update
notes.content:
Fixed a bug which affected some players, causing levels to randomly restart at times.

We understand that encountering unexpected restarts could be frustrating and disrupt the flow of your gameplay. We want to express our sincere apologies to those who experienced this issue. Rest assured, our team has been working tirelessly to identify and resolve this problem promptly.

We appreciate the feedback and support from our players in helping us improve Plasmatic. If you encounter any further issues, please let us know, and we'll address them promptly.

Thank you for your support! 💙

notes.title: Plasmatic 1.9.2.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
🔧 We've just released a small update to address some issues after 1.9.2 release.

Patch Notes 1.9.2.1:


 Fixed a bug that prevented players from completing level 14.
 Restored the wristwatch feature, so you can keep track of time in-game.
 Corrected minor language errors in the English version.
 Adjusted the shading of certain objects to enhance visual quality.
 Resolved flickering fans on levels 5, 12, and 17.
 Added level numbers back to the level selection menu in the main menu for easier navigation.


We appreciate the feedback and support from our players in helping us improve Plasmatic. If you encounter any further issues, please let us know, and we'll address them promptly. 

Thank you for your support! 💙

notes.title: Plasmatic 1.9.2 Update
notes.content:
Patch Notes 1.9.2:


 Introduced translations for Polish, German, French, Spanish, and Chinese, enabling a broader player base to enjoy the game.
 Improved texture quality for enhanced visual experience.
 Optimized RAM and VRAM usage by approximately 20%, resulting in smoother gameplay.
 Increased game performance through optimization efforts.
 Added Steam RichPresence feature, allowing you to share your achievements and current in-game status with other players.
 Enhanced font quality for better readability.
 Improved graphical settings, particularly the "Low" preset, which is now utilizing AMD FSR technology to enhance game smoothness on lower-end computers.
 Fixed the position of the elevator on levels 7 and 9 to prevent it from clipping into walls.

notes.title: DEMO Update!
notes.content:
DEMO Patch Notes:

[olist]

notes.title: Plasmatic - Update v 1.9
notes.content:
What's new in version 1.9?

- Updated game engine
- Updated the quality of many textures
- Updated lighting on Level 2
- Small graphical improvements
- Many "under the hood" bug fixes
- Added a warning on the monitor when SteamVR does not initialize correctly or does not detect any VR headset.

Many of the changes made are not visible, but they will allow us to introduce new and better content in future updates.

notes.title: Update 1.8.19
notes.content:
We've implemented some community-reported fixes in the latest update:

 New: There is a new Rotation Sensitivity Multiplier option (in Menu -> Options -> Gameplay).
 Fix: We have fixed performance issues related to the Ultra and High settings.
 Fix: Improved lighting at level 8.
 Fix: From now on, on failure, the screen first dims and then reloads the level - protects against a sudden and disruptive drop in game performance.
 Adjustment: The elapsed time reminder now starts at the last 1m 30s, up from 30s.

notes.title: What's new in full release?
notes.content:
What's the differences between demo and full release:
- Optimization for Oculus Quest users
- Default quality settings are now on medium
- Rotation Settings available (after steam discussion feedback - thank you guys <3)
- Lights are now more visible after filling the whole battery
- New Easter Egg lines from SPIRIT
- New collision sounds
- New time ending feature (Now lights and music are changing in the last seconds of current level, to increase the tension associated with the time running out)
- high and ultra settings fix
